mapper.select: SELECT a.*, c.name as club_name FROM activity a LEFT JOIN club c ON a.club_id = c.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT a.*, c.name as club_name FROM activity a LEFT JOIN club c ON a.club_id = c.id ORDER BY a.start_time DESC
SELECT a.*, c.name as club_name FROM activity a LEFT JOIN club c ON a.club_id = c.id WHERE a.club_id = #{clubId} ORDER BY a.start_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (club_id, title, content, location, start_time, end_time, max_participants, current_participants, check_in_code, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{clubId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{location}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{maxParticipants}, 0, #{checkInCode}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, location = #{location}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, max_participants = #{maxParticipants}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
